_meta.purpose: Canonical v2 auto-login configuration. Credentials are not stored here; use PURPLE_EMAIL / PURPLE_PASSWORD environment variables for local testing, or pass a per-account generated config from the launcher.

ui.note: The v2 Purple engine reads localized AutomationId/Name values and matches these exactly; words.lineage_card remains for legacy/GameFlow fallbacks.

legacy_mapping.userID/password: environment variables for the test runner; launcher per-account configs still carry credentials for the UI flow
legacy_mapping.words.lineage_card: legacy OCR/templates and GameFlow; v2 uses purple/engine.py GAME_CARD_TITLES
legacy_mapping.words.server_name: launcher account override for UI multi-account flow; local test runner uses this file's value unless overridden
legacy_mapping.page_positions: positions.normalize_page_positions() handles both legacy pixel and ratio forms
legacy_mapping.language/ocr_lang: GameFlow/base language hints; Purple v2 UIA identification is locale-specific but not language-config driven
legacy_mapping.click_mode: PositionStore fixed/dynamic mode; v2 Purple uses live UIA rectangles where available
